exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant
exam.study_prerequisites: Applied Dynamics 365 Customer Service and service-management knowledge across cases, knowledge, SLAs, queues, routing, representative workspace and Customer Voice, plus Dataverse, model-driven app, Power Automate, Teams and basic solution-architecture experience.

review.notes: Every March 11, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a case/data/security state, knowledge/collaboration/AI contract, SLA clock/action, routing stage, representative experience, extension/feedback decision, evidence, failure or recovery path. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover record rules/monitoring, resolution/roles/timeline, governed knowledge and Teams collaboration, filtered Copilot and controlled Case Management Agent/tools, SLA/item/KPI/KPI-instance/timer and reliable Power Automate behavior, unified routing/capacity/skills/diagnostics, scripts/slugs/macros, workspace templates/profiles/Inbox, Dataverse/UI/search/templates/notifications and Customer Voice. All 15 URLs are cataloged: 14 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the stale credential-page update messaging, active 100-minute seven-language exam, free Practice Assessment, 29h02 selected official paths, four-day course, current Pluralsight/Udemy supplements, partner learning and no exact verified O'Reilly, MeasureUp or Whizlabs product.

findings.title: Historical snapshot paraphrased two detailed bullets
findings.evidence: All 50 meanings match the same March 11 baseline; 48 bullets are byte-for-byte text matches.
findings.recommendation: Archive old objective/status bytes and audit references; accept full canonical extraction.
findings.resolution: Archive old objective/status bytes and audit references; accept full canonical extraction.

findings.title: Email intake needs active queue-linked rules
findings.evidence: Draft rules do not run and queue scopes cannot be converted in place.
findings.recommendation: Add concrete setup and troubleshooting boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add concrete setup and troubleshooting boundaries.

findings.title: Article relevance controls are not record isolation
findings.evidence: KnowledgeArticle boundary is the environment with table privileges; draft/internal content is not a secrets boundary.
findings.recommendation: Separate search filters from authorization and test actual access paths.
findings.resolution: Separate search filters from authorization and test actual access paths.

findings.title: Integrated search copies content rather than only federating
findings.evidence: Static sitemap content is ingested on a refresh schedule.
findings.recommendation: Compare copied/federated sources, freshness and governance.
findings.resolution: Compare copied/federated sources, freshness and governance.

findings.title: Teams handoff does not end an existing voice call
findings.evidence: The representative must end the existing call; recordings are separate Microsoft 365 artifacts.

findings.title: SLA pause/resume can replace the runtime instance
findings.evidence: Resume cancels the old instance and creates a new instance under effective pause precedence.
findings.recommendation: Correct integrated scenario and teach correlation rather than invariant instance ID.
findings.resolution: Correct integrated scenario and teach correlation rather than invariant instance ID.

findings.title: Calendar edits do not update every active deadline immediately
findings.evidence: Specific recalculation events use current schedules.
findings.recommendation: Add original holiday/pause example and in-flight transition planning.
findings.resolution: Add original holiday/pause example and in-flight transition planning.

findings.title: Capacity is an assignment allowance with overrides
findings.evidence: Manual assignment, reset behavior and custom limits can leave open work beyond the configured allowance.
findings.recommendation: Add negative-capacity and daily-reset examples; avoid absolute overload guarantee.
findings.resolution: Add negative-capacity and daily-reset examples; avoid absolute overload guarantee.

findings.title: Legacy diagnostics and suggestion features are retired
findings.evidence: Specific product retirement notice supersedes older enablement references.
findings.recommendation: Use current telemetry, record analytics and current Copilot/Teams guidance.
findings.resolution: Use current telemetry, record analytics and current Copilot/Teams guidance.

findings.title: Current tab does not replace anchor session context
findings.evidence: Additional tab records are separate from session anchor values.
findings.recommendation: Add wrong-record prevention and partial-replay example.
findings.resolution: Add wrong-record prevention and partial-replay example.

findings.title: Shadow evaluation has preview and consumption boundaries
findings.evidence: Setup documentation labels simulation/shadow preview and metered; configured confirmation remains a control.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded evaluation worksheet without enabling tenant actions or claiming GA execution proof.
findings.resolution: Add bounded evaluation worksheet without enabling tenant actions or claiming GA execution proof.

findings.title: Response limits and anonymous labels do not implement invitation policy
findings.evidence: Generic links, saved contacts and per-invitation response behavior differ.
findings.recommendation: Add stable invitation keys, distribution-route testing and correct outcome denominators.
findings.resolution: Add stable invitation keys, distribution-route testing and correct outcome denominators.

offline_checks: 31 local assertions: original business calendar/pause, capacity, case/work-item counts, proposal quality, survey response/idempotency and module-overlap/catalog checks.

limitations: No tenant configuration, agent execution, survey/email/Teams communication, telemetry export, Power Automate flow, paid course or assessment execution.
31 local assertions cover original calendar/arithmetic/count/identity and public catalog examples; they are not a Dynamics runtime, concurrency, delivery, billing or performance test.
Long product pages read selectively; complete connector, source, channel, role and regional matrices and linked procedures not audited.
Stale credential banner retained as discrepancy. Preview status and configured confirmation requirements control over broader blog/runtime wording; live tenant behavior remains to be validated.

Udemy direct fetch blocked and indexed metadata conflicts with earlier observation; current provider runtime is not established. Partner/practice access and other commercial catalog gaps not fully rechecked.
Same-context AI review; independent human review and live lab evidence remain pending.
